# JsBarcode

Barcode widgets for R. **JsBarcode** wraps the
[JsBarcode](https://github.com/lindell/JsBarcode) JavaScript library
(v3.12.3) as an [htmlwidget](https://www.htmlwidgets.org/), so you can
render 1D barcodes as SVG in the RStudio viewer, R Markdown / Quarto
documents and Shiny apps.

Documentation: <https://EnriquePH.github.io/JsBarcode/>

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("EnriquePH/JsBarcode")
```

## Usage

``` r

library(JsBarcode)

JsBarcode("Hello world")                                   # CODE128 (default)
JsBarcode("5901234123457", format = "EAN13")               # EAN-13
JsBarcode("123456", bar_height = 40, display_value = FALSE)
JsBarcode("ABC-123", line_color = "#1a4f8b", background = "transparent")

# Any other JsBarcode option can be passed with its JavaScript name
JsBarcode("Label", textAlign = "left", textPosition = "top", flat = TRUE)
```

Supported formats are listed in `barcode_formats`: CODE128 (A/B/C),
EAN-13, EAN-8, EAN-5, EAN-2, UPC-A, UPC-E, CODE39, CODE93, ITF, ITF-14,
MSI (10/11/1010/1110), Pharmacode and Codabar.

If a value is not valid for the chosen format (e.g. letters in EAN-13),
the widget shows an inline error message instead of a barcode.

## Shiny

``` r

library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(JsBarcodeOutput("code"))
server <- function(input, output) {
  output$code <- renderJsBarcode(JsBarcode("Hello Shiny"))
}
shinyApp(ui, server)
```

A complete demo ships with the package:

``` r

shiny::runApp(system.file("examples/shiny", package = "JsBarcode"))
```

## Development

Common tasks are wrapped in a `Makefile` (`make help` lists them):

``` sh
make test      # run the test suite
make check     # full R CMD check
make run       # install and launch the Shiny demo on port 3838
make site      # build the pkgdown site into docs/
make update-js # vendor the latest JsBarcode from npm
```

CI runs `R CMD check` on Linux, macOS and Windows for every push and
pull request. Every push to `main` rebuilds the documentation site and
deploys it to the `gh-pages` branch. See the [Development and
CI/CD](https://EnriquePH.github.io/JsBarcode/articles/development.html)
article for details.

# Package index

## Barcodes

- [`JsBarcode()`](https://EnriquePH.github.io/JsBarcode/reference/JsBarcode.md)
  : Create a barcode widget
- [`barcode_formats`](https://EnriquePH.github.io/JsBarcode/reference/barcode_formats.md)
  : Barcode formats supported by the bundled JsBarcode library

## Shiny

- [`JsBarcodeOutput()`](https://EnriquePH.github.io/JsBarcode/reference/JsBarcode-shiny.md)
  [`renderJsBarcode()`](https://EnriquePH.github.io/JsBarcode/reference/JsBarcode-shiny.md)
  : Shiny bindings for JsBarcode
